name: Projects
description: Projects capabilities. Includes Create a new API key for a project (requires organization-scoped API key), Create a new project (requires organization-scoped API key), Create or update a membership for a specific project (requires organization-scoped API key), Delete a membership from a specific project (requires organization-scoped API key), Delete a project by ID (requires organization-scoped API key), Delete an API key for a project (requires organization-scoped API key), Get all API keys for a project (requires organization-scoped API key), Get all memberships for a specific project (requires organization-scoped API key), and 2 more.
